unsupported_equipment.title: Unsupported BrewCreator device: {type}
unsupported_equipment.description: The BrewCreator account has device(s) of type "{type}" ({names}) that this integration does not support yet. Other devices keep working. Please open an issue and attach the integration's diagnostics download so support can be added.

set_batch_info.name: Set batch info
set_batch_info.description: Changes the batch info of a Ferminator, or of a Graviator not linked to one, in BrewCreator, such as its name, gravities and whether the brew is started. Only the fields you give or clear are changed. Give or clear at least one.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The Ferminator, or the Graviator not linked to a Ferminator, whose batch to change.

beer_style.name: Beer style
beer_style.description: Style of the beer, such as IPA or Scottish Export.

original_gravity.name: Original gravity
original_gravity.description: Specific gravity before fermentation, from 0.980 to 1.999. Must be above the final gravity.

final_gravity.name: Final gravity
final_gravity.description: Expected or measured specific gravity after fermentation, from 0.980 to 1.999. Must be below the original gravity.

ebc.name: EBC
ebc.description: Colour of the beer in EBC, a whole number of at least 1.

ibu.name: IBU
ibu.description: Bitterness in IBU, a whole number of at least 1.

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: Batch volume in litres, a whole number of at least 1.

started.name: Started
started.description: Start (true) or stop (false) the brew. BrewCreator logs the brew's readings while it is started.

clear.name: Clear
clear.description: Fields to clear, so they have no value. A field can't be both given and cleared.

no_batch_info.message: Device {device_id} is not a Ferminator or Graviator of a loaded BrewCreator integration.

linked_to_ferminator.message: {name} is linked to {ferminator}. Change the batch info on the Ferminator.

control_failed.message: Failed to change the temperature control of {name} in BrewCreator: {error}

final_gravity_not_below_original.message: The final gravity ({fg}) must be below the original gravity ({og}). Give both to change them together.

set_and_cleared.message: Can't both give and clear {fields}. Give a field a value or clear it.

update_failed.message: Failed to update the batch info of {name} in BrewCreator: {error}

link_failed.message: Failed to change the hydrometer linked to {name} in BrewCreator: {error}
